item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.41
item.description: Importers you add show on the main window, each with an on/off switch and a settings button; their settings open under them in Settings > Importers. An importer can declare its own settings (see the guide).

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.38
item.description: A YouTube search link means its top result only; a whole playlist is never downloaded without asking (in a list of links it's left out with a note). Pause and Stop work straight away while a list of links is being read. Job cards show the link's name. Notifications show Bad MxFer's own icon.
